result.reply:
That's a real bug, and whether it blocks isn't my call.

What I can tell you: it's silent data loss for people who took no action at all — other users in the workspace lose drafts because someone else left. That's a bad combination, wrong data touched, no warning, no undo mentioned.

Couple things I'd want before anyone sizes it: is this reproducible every time someone removes themselves, or only under some condition (e.g. last admin, specific draft state)? And is there any recovery path, or are the drafts actually gone? That changes "severe but rare edge case" vs "severe and easy to hit."
